title: Mortality prediction with adjuvant tamoxifen in breast cancer: Machine learning-integrated explainable artificial intelligence and Bayesian model results.
summary: The publisher study evaluated machine-learning mortality predictions among breast-cancer patients receiving adjuvant tamoxifen; the conclusion is limited to that study cohort and validation design.
ai_technology: The paper evaluates machine-learning mortality prediction for breast-cancer patients receiving adjuvant tamoxifen.
organization: Department of Pharmacology & Therapeutics, College of Medicine & Health Sciences, Arabian Gulf University, Manama, Kingdom of Bahrain
